name: com.hairporosityquiz/porosity-analyzer
title: Hair Porosity & 1A-4C Hair Type Analyzer
description: Deterministic 12-factor hair porosity, 1A-4C hair type, and routine calculator.

tools.name: list_hair_porosity_factors
tools.description: List all 12 deterministic hair porosity and 1A-4C hair-type assessment questions, valid option IDs, scoring weights, and Low/Medium/High porosity score thresholds.

tools.name: analyze_hair_porosity
tools.description: Calculate deterministic Low/Medium/High hair porosity score (0-100), 1A-4C hair type classification, strand width, elasticity, scalp profile, and cuticle factor breakdown from quiz answers. Full 6-section routine blueprint is unlocked on hairporosityquiz.com.

answers.description: Map of question IDs to option IDs (call list_hair_porosity_factors to inspect all valid IDs). Provide at least one factor; omitted factors use neutral midpoint defaults.

wetting_speed.description: Cuticle Water Resistance (weight 1.5): How fast does clean hair soak completely under running shower water? Options: beads_slow (Water beads up (60+ seconds to soak)); even_wetting (Wets evenly in 15 to 45 seconds); instant_soak (Soaks almost instantly (under 15 seconds)).

air_dry_time.description: Moisture Retention & Release (weight 1.5): How long does washed hair take to air-dry completely without heat? Options: slow_dry (4 hours or longer); moderate_dry (1.5 to 3.5 hours); fast_dry (Under 1.5 hours).

product_buildup.description: Surface Buildup Behavior (weight 1.2): How does your hair react to leave-in creams, oils, or serums? Options: sits_on_top (Sits on top and feels coated or greasy); absorbs_steady (Absorbs smoothly without residue); drinks_fast (Drinks product fast and feels dry again).

mist_absorbency.description: Dry-Strand Mist Test (weight 1.2): When you mist dry hair with plain water, what happens within 2 minutes? Options: droplets_sit (Tiny droplets rest on top of the strands); softens_slowly (Dampens evenly and softens gradually); vanishes_fast (Absorbs immediately and dries back rough).

strand_diameter.description: Strand Diameter (weight 0): Roll one shed strand between two fingers. How thick does it feel? Options: fine (Fine (hard to feel, thinner than thread)); medium_strand (Medium (similar to sewing thread)); coarse (Coarse (distinctly thicker or wiry)).

elasticity.description: Cortex Elasticity (weight 0): When you gently stretch a wet shed strand, how does it respond? Options: low_elasticity (Barely stretches and snaps quickly); balanced_elasticity (Stretches slightly and springs right back); high_stretch (Stretches far and stays limp or mushy).

curl_pattern.description: Natural Curl Pattern (1A-4C) (weight 0): When air-dried with zero styling product, what is your natural shape? Options: straight (Straight (1A-1C)); wavy (Wavy (2A-2C)); curly (Curly (3A-3C)); coily (Coily (4A-4C)).

scalp_oiliness.description: Scalp Sebum Cadence (weight 0): How soon after washing does your scalp feel oily or need a wash? Options: oily_scalp (Within 24 to 36 hours); balanced_scalp (Days 2 to 4); dry_scalp (Day 5+ or rarely feels oily).

chemical_heat.description: Heat & Chemical History (weight 1.4): What heat or chemical treatments has your hair had in the past 12 months? Options: virgin_no_heat (None (virgin hair, rare or no heat)); mild_color_heat (Occasional heat or single-process dye); bleached_high_heat (Bleach, highlights, perm, or frequent high heat).

humidity_response.description: Humidity & Dew-Point Reaction (weight 1): How does your hair behave on humid or rainy days? Options: stays_sleek (Stays sleek or falls slightly flatter); mild_halo (Mild halo frizz or softened shape); swells_puffs (Swells fast, puffs up, or loses definition).

breakage_splits.description: Cuticle Friction & Ends (weight 1): How often do you experience tangling, rough feel, or split ends? Options: smooth_rare_splits (Smooth feel and rare tangles); moderate_ends (Minor tangles at ends between trims); rough_splits (Rough cuticle feel, frequent knots, or splits).

conditioner_absorption.description: Conditioner Uptake (weight 1.2): In the shower, how does rinse-out conditioner behave on wet hair? Options: slippery_coat (Stays slippery on top and needs thorough rinsing); even_slip (Coats evenly and detangles in 1 to 2 minutes); vanishes_wants_more (Absorbs fast so strands still feel thirsty).

includeRoutineBlueprint.description: Optional compatibility flag. Free MCP responses return the deterministic porosity assessment and an unlock link for the full 6-section routine blueprint.
